newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds sees nearby trade on higher Chicago.
newsitem.headline: European feeds sees nearby trade on higher Chicago.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some nearby activity this afternoon after calls for a firmer Chicago soymeal futures opening.
"We saw nearby demand as Chicago was expected higher, but all in all demand was light on a high dollar and many dealers waiting for Wednesday's USDA crop reports," one dealer said.
Spot Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $307 a tonne cif Ghent and Sept at $295 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Afloat Argtentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $282 a tonne cif Rotterdam. Sept EU rapemeal traded at 26.50 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
